abysslib_relink.configuration.title: AbyssLib - ReLink Configuration
abysslib_relink.configuration.emissiveLa: Draw an extra fullbright layer for block textures that have a matching texture with the suffix below (OptiFine style).
abysslib_relink.configuration.emissiveSu: Suffix of the emissive overlay texture. OptiFine uses "_e". Empty disables the feature.
abysslib_relink.configuration.emissiveEx: Textures or namespaces that should not get an emissive overlay (prefix match, e.g. "minecraft:block/iron_ore" or "create:").
